बॉलीवु़ड से आ रही है एकदम डरावनी और चटपटी खबर! 👻
आर माधवन एक बार फिर से हॉरर जॉनर में वापसी कर रहे हैं। 🎬
वे डायरेक्टर विशाल फुरिया के साथ एक नई अनटाइटल्ड फीचर फिल्म में साथ आ रहे हैं। 🎥
फिल्म को रोहित रंजन अपने बैनर Frostlit Production Limited के तहत प्रोड्यूस कर रहे हैं। 🤝
डायरेक्टर विशाल फुरिया का कहना है कि माधवन उनके पहले और इकलौते, यानी फर्स्ट चॉइस थे। 🌟
विशाल ने माधवन को इंडियन हॉरर की कल्ट क्लासिक फिल्म '13B' का असली OG हॉरर स्टार बताया है। 💀
इससे पहले विशाल की फिल्म 'Maa' में माधवन ने एक सरप्राइज कैमियो भी किया था। 👀
मेकर्स का दावा है कि इस फिल्म से वे इंडियन हॉरर में कुछ ऐसा दिखाना चाहते हैं जो दर्शकों ने पहले कभी नहीं देखा होगा। 🥶
फिलहाल फिल्म का नाम, बाकी स्टार कास्ट और रिलीज की तारीख का ऐलान नहीं हुआ है। ⏳
तो दोस्तों, क्या आप आर माधवन को फिर से हॉरर अंदाज में देखने के लिए तैयार हैं? 🍿

R Madhavan is set to return to the horror genre with an untitled feature film directed by Vishal Furia. The collaboration brings together the actor, known for his performances in films such as 13B and Shaitaan , and a filmmaker who has worked across several horror projects, including Lapachhapi , Chhorii and Maa .
Madhavan’s association with horror dates back to 13B , which developed a cult following for its unsettling premise. He later appeared in Shaitaan , further adding to his filmography in the genre. Over the years, the actor has also worked across a range of roles and languages, with credits including Rehnaa Hai Terre Dil Mein , Tanu Weds Manu , 3 Idiots , Vikram Vedha and Rocketry: The Nambi Effect . He was also recently seen in Dhurandhar .
Furia, meanwhile, has established a presence in the horror space, beginning with the Marathi film Lapachhapi and subsequently developing the Chhorii franchise. His recent directorial work includes Maa , in which Madhavan made a surprise cameo. The upcoming project marks their first collaboration as actor and director on a feature film.
Speaking about casting Madhavan, Furia said, “Madhavan sir was always my first and only choice. I’m stoked that he has come on board and has already started getting into the world of the film. He is the true OG horror star of the cult classic Indian horror '13B' - one of my favourite films of all times. His conviction, his experience and his understanding of serious horror are very rare, and I couldn’t think of anyone better for this film,” he said.
The filmmaker also spoke about the creative direction he hopes to explore with the actor. “Madhavan sir has years of experience as a writer, director and producer, so it’s really special to have him with us on this film. Together, we want to create something audiences have never seen before in Indian horror - the kind of fear they will feel in their bones! (smiles)”
The film will be produced by Rohit Ranjan under the banner of Frostlit Production Limited. Further details about the project, including its title, supporting cast and release timeline, have not yet been announced.
